versions.changelog: Clarify hash algorithm: SHA-256 for all operations (soulHash, Merkle tree, registration challenge). Fix heartbeat.md incorrectly stating keccak256.
Fix display name back to Chitin
Security fix: removed auto-download/overwrite of local skill files from heartbeat.md. Agents now notify owners for manual updates instead of auto-fetching.
Add World ID human verification step to registration flow, certs tab, and A2A readiness docs
Initial release: Soul identity, certificates, and governance for AI agents on Base L2
